decision.rationale: Retain the completed local Qwen3 pair as the qualified provider control, but select no provider or retrieval method until the prospectively frozen hosted candidate is run and compared.
limitations: Only the local-control half of the provider comparison is complete.
Development evidence does not support a held-out generalization claim.
Boundary thresholds were calibrated and measured on the same five cases.
Fixed execution order makes workstation latency descriptive rather than comparative.
